name: The xx & Big Thief at Primavera
description: The festival kicks off with the ethereal sounds of The xx and the raw, lyrical power of Big Thief. A perfect start to a legendary weekend.
longDescription:
Primavera Sound Porto begins its 2026 edition with a double bill featuring The xx and Big Thief. The xx, the English indie pop band, are known for their minimalist soundscapes and dual male-female vocals. Brooklyn-based Big Thief, an indie rock band, are recognized for their poetic lyrics and dynamic live performances, fronted by Adrianne Lenker. This opening night sets the musical tone for the multi-day festival.

Attendees will experience an evening of contemporary music within the outdoor setting of Parque da Cidade. The atmosphere is characteristic of a large-scale music festival, with multiple stages and a diverse audience. The event takes place in the evening, offering a full concert experience under the open sky.

Admission is via a Day Ticket. Parque da Cidade is accessible via public transport, with bus routes serving the park. Specific bus numbers and stops can be found on the STCP website. The venue is an open-air park, generally accommodating for movement.
